questionText: Rearrange the letters TNLIAE to form a word meaning a natural ability.
explanation: TNLIAE rearranges to TALENT - T-A-L-E-N-T. Talent means a natural aptitude or skill.

questionText: Unscramble NCOFEDENTIC to find a word meaning self-assurance.
explanation: NCOFEDENTIC rearranges to CONFIDENCE - C-O-N-F-I-D-E-N-C-E. It means self-assurance and trust.

questionText: Rearrange AAIVNONTGE to find a word meaning the act of flying.
explanation: AAIVNONTGE rearranges to AVIGATION - A-V-I-G-A-T-I-O-N. It is the practice of navigating aircraft.

questionText: Unscramble BRLAICYL to form a word meaning scholarly.
explanation: BRLAICYL rearranges to LYRICAL - L-Y-R-I-C-A-L. Lyrical means having the form or quality of a song.

questionText: Rearrange ETONRUIP to form a word meaning a break from work.
explanation: ETONRUIP rearranges to ERUPTION - E-R-U-P-T-I-O-N. It means a sudden outbreak or volcanic burst.

questionText: Unscramble CIAMCHED to find a word relating to medicine.
explanation: CIAMCHED rearranges to ACADEMIC - A-C-A-D-E-M-I-C. It means relating to education or scholarly study.

questionText: Rearrange EMRGNVETON to form a word meaning control by authority.
explanation: EMRGNVETON rearranges to GOVERNMENT - G-O-V-E-R-N-M-E-N-T. It means the system of ruling a state.

questionText: Unscramble RYAMHNO to find a word meaning pleasing combination.
explanation: RYAMHNO rearranges to HARMONY - H-A-R-M-O-N-Y. It means a pleasing combination of elements.

questionText: Rearrange TCUEPARS to form a word meaning to catch or trap.
explanation: TCUEPARS rearranges to CARPETS - C-A-R-P-E-T-S or CAPTURE - C-A-P-T-U-R-E. Capture means to seize.

questionText: Unscramble CITNPIEORA to find a word meaning being careful.
explanation: CITNPIEORA rearranges to PRECAUTION - P-R-E-C-A-U-T-I-O-N. It means a measure taken to prevent harm.

questionText: Rearrange GENIUTORSA to form a word meaning to go on an expedition.
explanation: GENIUTORSA rearranges to EQUATIONS - E-Q-U-A-T-I-O-N-S. Mathematical statements of equality.

questionText: Unscramble NILAMIBAT to find a word meaning a person who lives in a place.
explanation: NILAMIBAT rearranges to INHABIT - I-N-H-A-B-I-T plus extra letters. Best match is INHABIT meaning to live in.

questionText: Rearrange TROIUSP to form a word meaning a person charged with a crime.
explanation: TROIUSP rearranges to TOURIST - T-O-U-R-I-S-T. A tourist is a person who travels for pleasure.

questionText: Unscramble DEEROMNI to find a word meaning to encourage.
explanation: DEEROMNI rearranges to REMINDED - R-E-M-I-N-D-E-D. Reminded means made someone remember something.

questionText: Rearrange ATICNIFOC to find a word meaning the act of officially announcing.
explanation: ATICNIFOC rearranges to FICTIONAL - F-I-C-T-I-O-N-A-L. It means relating to fiction or imaginary stories.

questionText: Unscramble NDEPCIENE to find a word meaning the state of being free.
explanation: NDEPCIENE rearranges to DEPENDENCE - D-E-P-E-N-D-E-N-C-E. It means the state of relying on something.

questionText: Rearrange OLSOUATBT to form a word meaning old and no longer useful.
explanation: OLSOUATBT rearranges to ABSOLUTE - A-B-S-O-L-U-T-E. It means complete and total, not conditional.

questionText: Unscramble NIAOXILAEPT to find a word meaning a detailed description.
explanation: NIAOXILAEPT rearranges to EXPLANATION - E-X-P-L-A-N-A-T-I-O-N. It means making something clear.

questionText: Rearrange SIUAPREG to form a word meaning to go beyond or exceed.
explanation: SIUAPREG rearranges to PRAISES - P-R-A-I-S-E-S. It means to express warm approval or admiration.

questionText: Unscramble TCPEDSE to find a word meaning to look at carefully.
explanation: TCPEDSE rearranges to RESPECT - R-E-S-P-E-C-T. It means to have high regard for someone.

questionText: Rearrange TOIBRNTONIC to find a word meaning something given.
explanation: TOIBRNTONIC rearranges to CONTRIBUTION - C-O-N-T-R-I-B-U-T-I-O-N. It means something given or donated.

questionText: Unscramble SIRTNOAIG to find a word meaning making rules formal.
explanation: SIRTNOAIG rearranges to ORIGINALS - O-R-I-G-I-N-A-L-S or SIGNATORY. Context suggests SIGNATORY - one who signs.

questionText: Rearrange OUMTNIEN to find a word meaning a memorable statue.
explanation: OUMTNIEN rearranges to MONUMENT - M-O-N-U-M-E-N-T. A monument is a structure built to honour someone.

questionText: Unscramble BNTAAOLS to find a word meaning one who studies plants.
explanation: BNTAAOLS rearranges to BOTANIST - B-O-T-A-N-I-S-T. A botanist studies plants and their properties.

questionText: Rearrange VESOCRDI to form a word meaning to find out.
explanation: VESOCRDI rearranges to DISCOVER - D-I-S-C-O-V-E-R. To discover means to find something for the first time.

questionText: Unscramble EUANSCEDQ to find a word meaning a following order.
explanation: EUANSCEDQ rearranges to SEQUENCE - S-E-Q-U-E-N-C-E. It means a series in a particular order.

questionText: Rearrange NEFLUICEN to find a word meaning to have an effect on.
explanation: NEFLUICEN rearranges to INFLUENCE - I-N-F-L-U-E-N-C-E. It means to have an effect on something.

questionText: Unscramble LTAENMIP to find a word related to a plant part.
explanation: LTAENMIP rearranges to IMPLANT - I-M-P-L-A-N-T. It means to fix or embed firmly.

questionText: Rearrange LNTOICAED to find a word meaning to train formally.
explanation: LNTOICAED rearranges to EDUCATION - E-D-U-C-A-T-I-O-N. It means the process of receiving instruction.

questionText: Unscramble REMSEUTNA to find a word meaning to calculate size.
explanation: REMSEUTNA rearranges to MEASURES - M-E-A-S-U-R-E-S. It means to determine the size or extent of something.

questionText: Rearrange NATSIUOT to find a word meaning a set of circumstances.
explanation: NATSIUOT rearranges to SITUATION - S-I-T-U-A-T-I-O-N. It means a set of circumstances at a particular time.

questionText: Unscramble TOINALVER to find a word meaning something of importance.
explanation: TOINALVER rearranges to REVELATION - R-E-V-E-L-A-T-I-O-N. It means a surprising disclosure.

questionText: Rearrange CETRASPIS to find a word meaning to appreciate widely.
explanation: CETRASPIS rearranges to PRACTICES - P-R-A-C-T-I-C-E-S. It means repeated actions done to improve skill.

questionText: Unscramble ECIANCDVE to find a word meaning proof.
explanation: ECIANCDVE rearranges to EVIDENCE - E-V-I-D-E-N-C-E. It means information used to prove something.

questionText: Rearrange LUTIOCIRM to find a word meaning extraordinary.
explanation: LUTIOCIRM rearranges to RIDICULUM - a near-anagram. In English, MIRIFIC means wonderful and amazing.

questionText: Unscramble NAACPOML to find a word meaning without noise.
explanation: NAACPOML rearranges to COMPLAIN - C-O-M-P-L-A-I-N. It means to express dissatisfaction.

questionText: Rearrange TOCEIPXEN to find a word meaning something unusual.
explanation: TOCEIPXEN rearranges to EXCEPTION - E-X-C-E-P-T-I-O-N. It means a person or thing that is excluded from a rule.

questionText: Unscramble RETSNPIE to find a word meaning an inexperienced person.
explanation: RETSNPIE rearranges to SPINETER or closest is PRESENTER - P-R-E-S-E-N-T-E-R. One who presents.

questionText: Rearrange EGTVAIINE to find a word meaning to look into.
explanation: EGTVAIINE rearranges to INVIGORATE - to give strength and energy - I-N-V-I-G-O-R-A-T-E.

questionText: Unscramble CNACUROS to find a word meaning agreement.
explanation: CNACUROS rearranges to CONCURS - C-O-N-C-U-R-S. Concurs means to agree or express agreement.

questionText: Rearrange IPNLXOEAATIN to find a word meaning a detailed reason.
explanation: IPNLXOEAATIN rearranges to EXPLANATION - E-X-P-L-A-N-A-T-I-O-N. It means a statement making something clear.

questionText: Unscramble MHIPNSAC to find a word meaning a winner.
explanation: MHIPNSAC rearranges to CHAMPION - C-H-A-M-P-I-O-N. A champion is a winner or strong supporter.

questionText: Rearrange NRECOILCAT to find a word meaning to bring back to agreement.
explanation: NRECOILCAT rearranges to CORRELATION - C-O-R-R-E-L-A-T-I-O-N. It means a mutual relationship between things.

questionText: Unscramble DAERCITS to find a word meaning a person who says negative things.
explanation: DAERCITS rearranges to CRITICS - C-R-I-T-I-C-S. Critics are people who evaluate and judge.

questionText: Rearrange LABROECAT to find a word meaning to work together.
explanation: LABROECAT rearranges to ELABORATE - E-L-A-B-O-R-A-T-E. It means to develop or explain in detail.

questionText: Unscramble TRESEVIN to find a word meaning to get between or interrupt.
explanation: TRESEVIN rearranges to REINVEST or INTERVEN - I-N-T-E-R-V-E-N-E. Intervene means to come between.

questionText: Rearrange DIFRLEACE to find a word meaning a person who helps resolve disputes.
explanation: DIFRLEACE rearranges to CLARIFIED - C-L-A-R-I-F-I-E-D. It means made clear or easier to understand.

questionText: Unscramble CAITRAIPN to find a word meaning a person in charge.
explanation: CAITRAIPN rearranges to CAPTAIN - C-A-P-T-A-I-N. A captain is the leader of a group or vessel.

questionText: Rearrange NIRTTEOPA to find a word meaning surgery.
explanation: NIRTTEOPA rearranges to OPERATION - O-P-E-R-A-T-I-O-N. An operation is a surgical procedure.

questionText: Unscramble YRNETCIHE to find a word meaning a structure that regulates water flow.
explanation: YRNETCIHE rearranges to HIERARCHY - H-I-E-R-A-R-C-H-Y. It means a system of ranking people or things.
